en: We will battle these fiends, together! Nighthaven's Defenders are also among us. They will fight to the death if asked. Now, quickly, we must drive these aberrations back to the Nightmare. Destroy them all!
My education is ongoing, and your knowledge surpasses mine. If you wish to learn more you must speak to Me'lynn. She will guide you.
Elune be praised!  You seek out our Warsong Gulch Battlemaster?  Her name is Aethalas, and she stands ready to greet you near the warrior trainers.
%s rolls on the floor laughing.
What is there to do on Hallow's End?
Thanks to the Warchief, even here in the ruins of our former prison, some hope remains, and the Horde rises anew.
I have no time for you, $r. Continue on your way.
You have some skill, it is true, but every moment I spend teaching you is one more moment the undead will spend in torment. Prove to me that you are worth my time.
The time has come, my $g brother : sister; in arms, to take back the night from the Scourge!
Hey Jangdor - can you teach me again how to make a Wild Leather Vest again?
Just sit right back and you'll hear a ta... *hic* a tai... *hic* a taiiii *hic* Damnit!
This cannot be!  I am the master here!  You mortals are nothing to my kind!  Do you hear me? Nothing!
The spirits have brought you to me, and so I feel blessed by them.
Cleanse your hands before you begin any project. Staining the leather with blood or dirt would take away from its natural beauty.
Thank you! Thank you, $gpriest:priestess;. Now I can take on those corrupt timberlings with Elune's power behind me!
Stop whining!

Yes, yes, all of the Horde's and Alliance's war materiel is being shipped over to Silithus and should be there within $2113w days. Do you know what happens then, $c? We hurry up and wait. Hopefully someone is gathering the pieces of the Scepter of the Shifting Sands, because in order to open the gates of Ahn'Qiraj it needs to be rung against the gong on the Scarab Dais.
You have come to me for instruction, and in return I have a favor to ask of you. See it done, and you will be rewarded.

My purpose is to regulate access to the Uldum complex for the Creators.  I allow entry into the compound only when the solicitor exhibits for access the proper sequencing discs.$B$BYour disc set currently does not contain the Plates of Uldum, the primary prerequisite for entry.  Access is not granted unless the Plates of Uldum are present.
You want Zamja at Borstan's Firepit on the upper level of The Drag.  Go up the stairs on the left as you enter The Drag from the Valley of Strength.
Gimme the tiger cub!
Remember, I need your help to properly channel. I will ask you to aid me several times on our path, so please be ready.
Tower Point was taken by the Horde!
%s start pushing each other back and forth.
So ye want to be a Blacksmith eh? Grab an apron and a hammer $g lad : lass;, let's see what ye've got.
No more play?
I hope that you're here to help us take back Arathi Basin from The Defilers.  What do you say $n?
Let me go get you a set of tools, $n.
What goods have I earned the right to purchase from the League of Arathor?
Aber?  Is that you...?  Oh...I'm so hungry, Aber!  SO HUNGRY!!
Here to visit the family?  Die, fool!
Red wins! Prepare for next round.
Thanks again for returning my lucky measuring tape, $n.  I swear it helps me catch bigger fish!
What is an Alliance Commendation Signet?
May Elune walk with you, $c.  The Temple of the Moon has come to help the troubled citizens of Auberdine.
How the hell did you get in there to begin with?
Tell me of Frostwolf Keep.
Ah, mistletoe...
%s regains its power and breaks free of its bonds!
I miss the dwarven ale we used to get at that inn in Lordaeron. Remember that fight we started there?

Your fortune is cast, $c.  For the next few hours, you will find your spirit in tune with your true nature.  Be careful, as your fortune - and your fate - are never as clear as you might think them to be.$B$BIf you would like a small glimpse of something to ponder in your future, by all means let me know.  I'd be happy to give you a written fortune, provided you have room in your inventory.  It is one drawn from the insight you have shown in answering my questions.
Revenge shall be mine at last!
What was that noise? It sounded like a roar.
You're never going to stop coming after me, are you?  Fine, but you won't take me down without a fight!
I can sense it now, $n. Ashenvale lies down this path.
I come from the land down under... where women plague and men sunder.

Greetings, $c - I'm a Commendation Officer acting on behalf of the Undercity.  It is my duty to assist adventurers who have received Horde Commendation Signets.$B$BI accept signets in different quantities, but the most beneficial exchange for you is to hand in a set of ten at once.  I will enter your deeds into our records when you hand in your signets.  As a result, you will earn recognition from the Undercity for your duty and service.
